title: hybrid.rs: Route injection via unsolicited RREP - no active discovery validation
description: on_rrep_received (line 428) installs gradient entries and records local evidence without validating that an active discovery exists for the destination. The active_discoveries.retain() on line 453 happens AFTER route installation and is not used as a guard. An attacker can send spoofed RREP packets to inject arbitrary routes pointing traffic to attacker-controlled next_hop addresses. Should check active_discoveries contains dst BEFORE installing the gradient entry.
close_reason: Fixed: Added active discovery validation guard before installing gradient entries. on_rrep_received (line 474) and handle_incoming_rrep (line 544) now check active_discoveries.iter().any(|d| d.destination == dst) before installing routes. Unsolicited RREPs are dropped to prevent route injection attacks.
